name: Verdict
overview: The biblical verdict against Jesus, as recorded in the Gospels, reveals a miscarriage of justice driven by human rejection of the Messiah. Despite Pilate’s recognition of Jesus’ innocence and his symbolic act of washing his hands to disclaim responsibility, the crowd insisted on condemning Jesus to death, even declaring His blood upon themselves and their descendants. This verdict led to Jesus being scourged and ultimately crucified, fulfilling the divine plan through human rejection and unjust judgment.
